spec.description: (a+b)(c+d)=ac+ad+bc+bd with four red arcs: from a to c and d above the product, from b to c and d below; the law is drawn inside the diagram so the arrows align with its terms.
spec.mathematics: every term of the first bracket multiplies every term of the second

teachingContext.method: Expand (a+b)(c+d) by multiplying every term of the first bracket by every term of the second, then simplify.

customArrangement.reason: The red arrows must overlay the terms of (a+b)(c+d) to show which terms multiply, so the rule and arrows are one diagram placed above the steps.
